mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals tightening monetary policy during labor market strength, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high labor market tightness (unemployment rate below 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals sustained labor strength supporting corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST has increased for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand patterns, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST rising and RSAFS falling does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle supply constraints regime (industrial production growth below 1.0% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth is below 1.0% YoY.
